sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics

Players use the mouse, keyboard, or touch controls to navigate the golf ball through a 2D environment, with the primary objective of reaching the hole in the fewest strokes possible. The game features a range of obstacles, including sand traps, rocks, and water hazards, which players must overcome to achieve optimal scores. Players can also collect stars and power-ups to enhance their gameplay experience.
